title: InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.19472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperspectral models of fish freshness rarely transfer between species, and labelling a new species is slow and destructive. Freshness is also ordinal, and standard domain alignment can erase that order. We present InvarOrd, which adapts to a new species from 30 labelled cubes (5 per rank) in three stages: self-supervised spectral pretraining on unlabelled source cubes, cross-species alignment by a shrinkage covariance discrepancy computed only within matched ranks, and ordinal distillation into a compact student. The alignment term is provably invariant to the rank means, so it gives no incentive to collapse the ordinal axis. On paired salmon and cod data (800 cubes each, 16 days), a source-trained teacher reaches 1.6 to 1.9 days mean absolute error (MAE) on the other species, with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) below zero. The 423K-parameter student, 2.54 times smaller than its teacher, attains the lowest MAE (1.476 days) and highest

translated_title: InvarOrd：基于秩不变对齐的自监督有序知识蒸馏，用于标签高效的跨物种高光谱鱼类新鲜度评估
translated_abstract: 鱼类新鲜度的高光谱模型很少能够在不同物种之间迁移，而对新物种进行标注既缓慢又具有破坏性。同时，新鲜度本身是有序的，而标准的域对齐方法可能会抹去这种顺序关系。我们提出InvarOrd，该方法仅需30个有标注的立方体数据（每个等级5个）即可适应新物种，分为三个阶段：在未标注的源域立方体数据上进行自监督光谱预训练；通过仅在匹配等级内计算的收缩协方差差异进行跨物种对齐；以及将有序知识蒸馏到一个紧凑的学生模型中。该对齐项可被证明对等级均值是不变的，因此不会产生压缩有序轴的倾向。在成对的鲑鱼和鳕鱼数据上（各800个立方体，历时16天），源域训练的教师模型在另一物种上达到1.6至1.9天的平均绝对误差（MAE），且二次加权Kappa（QWK）低于零。这个42.3万参数的学生模型比其教师模型小2.54倍，实现了最低的MAE（1.476天）和最高的
tldr: 提出InvarOrd方法，通过秩不变对齐与有序知识蒸馏，仅需30个标注样本即可将鱼类新鲜度高光谱评估模型跨物种迁移，紧凑学生模型在参数减少2.54倍的情况下实现了最低的1.476天平均绝对误差。
en_tdlr: InvarOrd enables label-efficient cross-species transfer of hyperspectral fish freshness models using only 30 labelled samples, via provably rank-invariant alignment and ordinal knowledge distillation into a compact student that achieves the lowest MAE of 1.476 days.
